characters.summary: Guy Smiley is an enthusiastic game show host who fights primarily through verbal persuasion, rapid-fire questioning, and overwhelming broadcasting energy. He possesses no combat-oriented offense or defense, relying purely on social engagement and performance.
limitations: Relies entirely on verbal hosting scenarios

sources.supports: General history as a game show host on Sesame Street and The Muppet Show

feats.claim: Hosted numerous game shows and interviews on Sesame Street and The Muppet Show

unknowns: No documented combat encounters or physical feats

limitations: Prone to gentle restraint rather than aggressive combat

characters.summary: Hilda is a wardrobe mistress and dresser on The Muppet Show who uses practical organization, wardrobe management, and sharp commentary to navigate her environment. She has no combat capabilities.

sources.supports: Background as the dresser and wardrobe worker on The Muppet Show

feats.claim: Managed the wardrobe and costumes for the entire Muppet cast

characters.summary: Johnny Fiama is a smooth-talking crooner backed by his gorilla bodyguard, Sal Minella. He fights through social intimidation, mobster-style posturing, and relying entirely on Sal for physical defense.

mechanisms: Using Sal Minella as human shield or muscle

limitations: Physically weak on his own without Sal Minella

sources.supports: Background as a traditional crooner accompanied by Sal Minella

feats.claim: Ran lounge musical acts and commanded his bodyguard Sal Minella

mechanisms: Massive size advantage over small opponents

sources.supports: Role as the young Gorg in Fraggle Rock, size, and characteristics

unknowns: Combat effectiveness against opponents of his own scale

limitations: Lacks supernatural powers or heavy offensive output

sources.supports: History as the host and central leader of the Muppets
